{{Quote|A depiction of the Dreamer and the Monster-Slayer in their battle for Sith supremacy circa 3400 BBY.|Annotation by Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Deluxe" />}}
According to a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] legend, two Sith known as the [[Dreamer]] and the [[Monster-Slayer]] engaged each other in a '''lightsaber duel''' around [[3400 BBY]]. However, both [[Death/Legends|died]] due to the effects of the [[Gas/Legends|vapors]] of the [[Pits of Paxxis]] at which the duel was taking place. [[Millennium/Legends|Millennia]] later, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] annotated an illustration depicting the confrontation.

==The duel==
{{Quote|Both died, overcome by the vapors from the Pits of Paxxis.|Annotation by Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Deluxe" />}}
According to a legend of the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] tradition of [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-users]], the two Sith known respectively as the [[Dreamer]] and the [[Monster-Slayer]] faced each other in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]] for supremacy among the Sith. The confrontation took place in the vicinity of the [[Pits of Paxxis]] around [[3400 BBY]], with each of the combatants wielding a pair of [[Sith lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]]. However, both ultimately [[Death/Legends|perished]] due to the harmful effects of the [[Gas/Legends|vapors]] of the Pits of Paxxis.<ref name="Deluxe" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|This is one of the many Sith legends that appears to be rooted in fact.|Annotation by Luke Skywalker|<ref name="Deluxe" />}}
The duel between the Dreamer and the Monster-Slayer was eventually depicted in an illustration which ended up in the possession of [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]],<ref name="Deluxe" /> the leader of a [[New Jedi Order|new incarnation]] of the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], which was the traditional enemy of the Sith.<ref name="JediPath">[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]</ref> Skywalker included the illustration in a compilation of two [[Book/Legends|books]]&mdash;the [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Jedi trainee]] guidebook ''[[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force]]''<ref name="JediPath" /> and the Sith volume ''[[Book of Sith]]''<ref name="BookOfSith">''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''</ref>&mdash;that had been recovered by [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]].<ref name="JediPath" /><ref name="BookOfSith" /> In an annotation on the picture, the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] also noted that the legend about the confrontation between the two Sith appeared to have a factual basis.<ref name="Deluxe" />

==Behind the scenes==
The duel was introduced in an art print that was included in ''[[Star Wars: The Jedi Path and Book of Sith Deluxe Box Set]]'',<ref name="Deluxe" /> a [[2014]] box set collecting<ref name="Chronicle">{{Chronicle|url=jedi-path-and-book-of-sith-deluxe-box-set.html|text=Star Wars®: The Jedi Path and Book of Sith Deluxe Box Set|nolive=1}}</ref> [[Daniel Wallace]]'s [[2010]] reference book [[The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force (real-life book)|''The Jedi Path: A Manual for Students of the Force'']]<ref name="First Look">{{SWArchive|url=vault/books/jedipath/index.html|text=First Look: ''The Jedi Path''}}</ref> and Wallace's [[2012]] reference book ''[[Book of Sith: Secrets from the Dark Side]]''.<ref name="Amazon Box">{{WebCite|url=http://www.prweb.com/releases/starwars/bookofsith/prweb8875603.htm|text=Just in Time for New York Comic Con, Lucasfilm™ Announces the Discovery of BOOK OF SITH: Secrets from the Dark Side|date=2011-10-13|work=[http://www.prweb.com PRWeb]|archivedate=20111115030034|nolive=1}}</ref>
